info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Replace Hotel Loyalty Points Transfer-v5-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Transfer API enables businesses to seamlessly transfer loyalty points between hotel loyalty program members. This operation allows for updating existing transfers to ensure accurate accounting and member satisfaction. Ideal for hotel chains and loyalty program managers, this API supports essential interactions for maintaining customer engagement and loyalty program integrity. Use cases include resolving transfer errors and adjusting points due to promotions or member requests.

put.description: This endpoint allows users to transfer points to another user. The request should include the recipient's user ID and the number of points to transfer. Ensure that the sender has sufficient balance before attempting the transfer.
